description: The file 'applied.diff' must exist and be a valid unified diff format.
criteria: File exists and content matches unified diff regex patterns (e.g., starts with 'diff --git' or '---')

description: The applied diff must contain exactly one hunk (one '@@' header) corresponding to the selected hunk.
criteria: Count of lines starting with '@@' is exactly 1

description: The applied diff must not contain any lines from the unselected hunk.
criteria: No lines from the second hunk's context or changes are present in the file

description: The applied diff must be applicable to the original file without conflicts.
criteria: Running 'git apply --check applied.diff' (or equivalent) succeeds without errors
